description:
Search Danish parliamentary afstemninger/stemmer, meaning aggregate vote results for a case step.
            This does not search individual person or party votes. Category filters should usually be omitted for
            initial searches and used only for refinement.

case_type_id.description: Related case type ID from the case type vocabulary resource.

category_id.description:
Advanced refinement filter. Use only when the user explicitly asks
        for this category or to narrow an already-inspected result set; categories are difficult to distinguish and
        should usually be omitted for initial searches.

from_date.description: Earliest meeting date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

include_change_proposals.description: Include amendment/change proposal afstemninger. Defaults to false.

keyword_text.description: Natural-language topic text. Prefer this when exact keyword IDs are ambiguous.

query.description: Free-text query for Danish case title or case number.

to_date.description: Latest meeting date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

vote_cast_type_id.description: Afstemning type ID from the vote cast/event type vocabulary resource.

name: search_vote_casts
